_doc: Burger-menu knowledge base for Vavoom Assist (RAG): built by scripts/build-menu-kb.py from the Five Guys Canada Nutrition, Ingredient & Allergen Guide (page 1 CA 12-2023, page 2 CA 10-2024) and one Ontario store's online prices. Do not edit by hand; rerun the script. Allergens are the guide's 11 columns plus barley (malt vinegar).

source.guide: Five Guys Canada Nutrition, Ingredient & Allergen Guide (fiveguys.ca, accurate as of 12-2023 / 10-2024)
source.prices: Five Guys, 770 Gardiners Rd, Kingston ON — online menu (order.online), read 2026-10-08; prices vary by franchise
source.descriptions: written for Vavoom from fiveguys.ca menu pages (2026-10-08)

cautions.fries: Fries are cooked in 100% refined peanut oil.
